subtitle: Dated Silver and the Silent Chronicle of the Western Kshatrapas

panels.shot: dramatic close-up of a silver coin held between thumb and forefinger against a hazy backdrop of ancient Gujarat trade port
panels.action: The Western Kshatrapa Mint-Master holds up a freshly struck silver coin, its tiny portrait glinting in the coastal sun as ships and caravans blur in the distance.

dialogue.text: In an age without chronicles, the Western Kshatrapas left their story not on palm leaves, but on silver—three centuries of dates and faces pressed into metal.

i18n.hi: इतिहास-लेखों के बिना ज़माने में, पश्चिमी क्षत्रपों ने कथा ताड़-पत्र पर नहीं, चाँदी पर लिखी—तीन सौ साल की तारीख़ें और चेहरे, धातु में दबे हुए।

panels.shot: wide establishing shot over an ancient port city with warehouses, masts of ships, and distant hills
panels.action: The Mint-Master stands on a rooftop terrace overlooking a bustling western port, with warehouses, caravans and ships hinting at routes to Arabia and the Deccan.

dialogue.text: From Saurashtra’s harbours to Malwa’s plains, silver traveled farther than any satrap. Each coin carried a portrait, a name, a number—the empire measured in drachms.

i18n.hi: सौराष्ट्र के घाटों से मालवा के मैदानों तक, चाँदी हर क्षत्रप से ज़्यादा दूर गई। हर सिक्का साथ लाया चेहरा, नाम, अंक—द्राख्मों में तौला गया साम्राज्य।

panels.shot: medium shot inside a mint workshop, low-angle to emphasize furnaces and organized tools
panels.action: Inside a dim mint, the Mint-Master oversees furnaces, weighed ingots and rows of hammermen poised over paired dies.

dialogue.text: The Western Kshatrapas inherited more than land. They took Indo-Greek weight, portrait and legend, and forged them into their own language of power.

i18n.hi: पश्चिमी क्षत्रपों ने सिर्फ़ ज़मीन नहीं पाई। उन्होंने इंडो-यूनानी बाट, चित्र और लिखावट उठाई, और उन्हें अपनी सत्ता की भाषा में ढाल दिया।

panels.shot: extreme close-up of an obverse die showing a king’s bust in Indo-Greek style
panels.action: The Mint-Master gently brushes a steel die, revealing a sharp-profile bust with diadem and cloak in clear Indo-Greek style.

dialogue.text: On one face, the king’s head, after Greek models—diadem, cloak, sharp nose in profile. A foreign art, bent now to Saka satrap pride.

i18n.hi: एक तरफ़ राजा का सिर, यूनानी नमूने पर—मुकुट-बन्ध, चोगा, नुकीली नाक,横 से चेहरा। परायी कला, अब शाका क्षत्रपों के गौरव में झुकी।

panels.shot: close-up of the reverse of a coin, showing Brahmi legend around a central symbol
panels.action: A finished coin rests on the Mint-Master’s palm, its reverse ringed with crisp Brahmi letters and a central symbol.

dialogue.text: On the other face, the words turned Indian. In Brahmi script the satrap named himself, his father, his office, and the year from a Saka era.

i18n.hi: दूसरी तरफ़ शब्द हो गए देसी। ब्राह्मी में क्षत्रप ने लिखा—अपना नाम, पिता का नाम, अपनी उपाधि, और शक संवत् का साल।

panels.shot: over-the-shoulder shot as the Mint-Master inspects a coin with faint, clumsy Greek letters at the margin
panels.action: The Mint-Master peers closely at a coin whose outer rim holds faint, distorted Greek letters barely holding their form.

dialogue.text: Around the margin, ghostly Greek letters lingered. Once clear legends, now slowly corrupting—ritual echoes of a language no longer spoken in the mint.

i18n.hi: किनारे पर फीके यूनानी अक्षर अटके रहे। कभी साफ़ लिखावट, अब बिगड़ती हुई—टकसाल में मर चुकी ज़ुबान की रस्मी गूँजें।

panels.shot: medium shot of the Mint-Master pointing to a Brahmi legend on a tablet sketch, flanked by apprentices
panels.action: The Mint-Master, stern and precise, points to a wax tablet sketch of Brahmi lines as apprentices watch, reed pens in hand.

dialogue.speaker: the_western_kshatrapa_mints
dialogue.text: Name the king, name his father, and never forget the year.

i18n.hi: राजा का नाम, उसके पिता का नाम, और साल कभी न भूलो।

panels.shot: dynamic montage-style wide shot of coins being struck in sequence, each with a different king’s name
panels.action: In a time-lapse-like spread, hammermen strike coins while behind them faint images of successive busts—different diadems, hairstyles—seem to overlap in the air.

dialogue.text: One satrap died, another rose. Scrolls perished, but the dies changed. Year after year, new names and dates marched onto silver.

i18n.hi: एक क्षत्रप मरा, दूसरा उठा। पत्र नष्ट हुए, पर नक्क़ाशी के साँचे बदलते रहे। साल दर साल, नए नाम और तारीख़ें चाँदी पर मार्च करती रहीं।

panels.shot: split-scene shot juxtaposing a crumbling palm-leaf manuscript and a carefully arranged tray of coins
panels.action: On one side, a brittle palm-leaf manuscript curls and cracks; on the other, the Mint-Master arranges a neat tray of bright, durable coins.

dialogue.text: Inscriptions on stone were few. Palm leaves rotted in monsoon air. But coins, small and stubborn, passed from hand to hand, outliving their makers.

i18n.hi: पत्थर पर शिलालेख कम थे। ताड़-पत्र मानसून में सड़ गए। पर सिक्के, छोटे पर जिद्दी, हाथों से हाथों में घूमते रहे, बनाने वालों से ज़्यादा जीते।

panels.shot: bird’s-eye view of a trade route map drawn in sand, with coins marking nodes at ports and inland markets
panels.action: Kneeling on packed earth, the Mint-Master draws lines between miniature hills and waves, placing coins at key crossings like gleaming markers.

dialogue.text: Through Ujjain and Bharukaccha, through Malwa’s markets and western ports, satrap coins paid soldiers, taxed merchants, and tied distant towns to a dated rhythm.

i18n.hi: उज्जयिनी और भरुकच्च, मालवा के बाज़ारों और पश्चिमी बंदरों से होकर, क्षत्रप सिक्के सिपाहियों की मज़दूरी बने, व्यापारियों पर कर, और दूर नगरों को तारीख़ों की एक ही धुन में बाँधते रहे।

panels.shot: medium shot of the Mint-Master weighing foreign Roman-style silver against Western Kshatrapa coins
panels.action: The Mint-Master carefully balances a Roman-style silver coin against Western Kshatrapa silver on a beam scale, eyes narrowed in calculation.

dialogue.text: Foreign silver came by sea. The satraps answered with their own—matching weight and fineness, but stamping it with their chronicle and their face.

i18n.hi: पराई चाँदी समुंदर से आई। क्षत्रपों ने अपनी चाँदी से जवाब दिया—वज़न और ख़ालिसी बराबर, पर उस पर अपनी दास्तान और अपना चेहरा थप गया।

panels.shot: close-up of a coin reverse where the Saka era numeral is clearly visible in Brahmi
panels.action: A coin fills the frame, its Brahmi numerals for a Saka era year sharply carved beneath the king’s titles.

dialogue.text: The numbers were more than account marks. They fixed each coin in time, year by year, in a Saka era that later scholars would slowly decode.

i18n.hi: अंकों की हैसियत हिसाब से ज़्यादा थी। उन्होंने हर सिक्के को समय में बाँध दिया, साल दर साल, एक शक संवत् में, जिसे आगे चलकर विद्वानों ने धीरे-धीरे पढ़ा।

panels.shot: medium shot in a future time: a modern-looking scholar’s silhouette discovering a hoard, while the Mint-Master appears ghostlike behind
panels.action: In a dim trench, a silhouetted modern excavator lifts a cluster of tarnished coins; behind him, translucent, the Mint-Master watches in quiet satisfaction.

dialogue.text: Centuries later, when chronicles were silent, hoards emerged from fields and riverbeds. Numismatists read the dates and names the mints had sealed.

i18n.hi: सदियों बाद, जब लिखित इतिहास चुप था, खेतों और नदी-तलों से ख़ज़ाने निकले। मुद्राशास्त्रियों ने उन पर जमी तारीख़ें और नाम पढ़े।

panels.shot: close-up of a scholar’s hand aligning coins in chronological order on a table
panels.action: A scholar’s hand arranges Western Kshatrapa coins in a careful line, portraits and legends forming a silent sequence, as the Mint-Master’s faint reflection overlays the table surface.

dialogue.text: From these small circles of silver, scholars stitched a ruler list—fathers, sons, overlords—where no royal genealogy survived on paper.

i18n.hi: इन्हीं छोटी चाँदी की गोलियों से विद्वानों ने वंश-सूची जोड़ी—पिता, बेटे, अधिपति—जहाँ काग़ज़ पर कोई राजवंशी वंशावली नहीं बची थी।

panels.shot: medium shot of the Mint-Master examining a coin with very degenerate Greek letters, brow furrowed
panels.action: The Mint-Master frowns at a new coin where the outer Greek legend has become nearly illegible, its letters twisted into mere strokes.

dialogue.text: Yet the outer Greek grew ever more clumsy—letters copied by rote, not by voice. A fossil script, kept from habit and prestige, not everyday speech.

i18n.hi: पर बाहर की यूनानी लिपि और बेढंगी होती गई—अक्षर रटकर नकल किए, ज़बान से नहीं। एक जीवाश्म लिपि, जो आदत और प्रतिष्ठा से बची रही, रोज़ की बोली से नहीं।

panels.shot: wide shot of the mint in decline, fewer workers, with new rulers’ symbols hinted in the background
panels.action: The mint hall now has empty corners; fewer workers strike fewer coins, as distant banners of rising powers flutter beyond the doorway.

dialogue.text: In time, other powers pressed their marks into western India. The satraps’ line faltered, their mints slowed, but their dated silver did not vanish.

i18n.hi: वक़्त के साथ और ताक़तों ने पश्चिमी भारत पर अपनी मुहरें दबाईं। क्षत्रपों की रेखा डगमगाई, टकसालें धीमी पड़ीं, पर उनका तारीख़दार चाँदी का सिक्का ग़ायब नहीं हुआ।

panels.shot: intimate close-up of the Mint-Master placing a final coin into a clay jar, lit by a small lamp
panels.action: By lamplight, the Mint-Master lowers a small pile of freshly struck coins into a clay jar, sealing it as if entrusting it to the earth.

i18n.hi: धातु वो सब याद रखती है, जो आदमी भूल जाते हैं।

panels.shot: final contemplative wide shot blending past and present landscapes of Gujarat with coins superimposed over the horizon
panels.action: The landscape of Gujarat stretches from ancient ports to modern towns; above the horizon, faint Western Kshatrapa coins hang like small, weathered moons, the Mint-Master’s figure fading into them.

dialogue.text: Three centuries of dated silver turned a satrap’s money into a metal archive. In every worn coin, a kingdom’s brief command over time still rests in the palm.

i18n.hi: तीन सदियों की मुहरदार चाँदी ने क्षत्रपों की मुद्राओं को धातु का अभिलेख बना दिया। हर घिसे सिक्के में, समय पर राज्य की क्षणभर की हुकूमत आज भी हथेली में ठहरी है।

title_i18n.hi: तीन सदियों की मुहर लगी चाँदी

subtitle_i18n.en: Dated Silver and the Silent Chronicle of the Western Kshatrapas
subtitle_i18n.hi: मुहरदार चाँदी और पश्चिमी क्षत्रपों की मौन कहानी
